roles.name: Backend Development
roles.description: Pilot subset: HTTP services, application data, behaviour checks and basic code delivery. Stack alternatives are guidance, not cumulative requirements.

roles.name: QA Automation
roles.description: Pilot subset: test-case design, functional checks, reproducible defects and basic check delivery. This is not an exhaustive job specification.

capabilities.name: Git
capabilities.definition: Track and combine source-code changes using commits, branches and merges.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Create a branch, commit a change and resolve a simple merge conflict.

capabilities.name: SQL
capabilities.definition: Read and modify relational data using SQL statements, filters and joins.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Query two related tables with a join and explain the result.

capabilities.name: JavaScript
capabilities.definition: Write JavaScript functions and asynchronous operations in a small program.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Implement a function and handle success and failure of an asynchronous operation.

capabilities.name: HTTP API basics
capabilities.definition: Use HTTP methods, status codes, headers and structured request/response bodies.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Send a request, inspect its response and explain a successful and an error status.

capabilities.name: Testing basics
capabilities.definition: Check one isolated software behaviour with a repeatable assertion.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Write and run a small passing assertion and a deliberately failing one.

capabilities.name: Linux command line
capabilities.definition: Navigate files, inspect output and run commands in a Linux shell.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Navigate a project directory and use a command and output redirection safely.

capabilities.name: CI workflow basics
capabilities.definition: Configure a delivery workflow that automatically runs project checks on a code change.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Configure a check job and explain a passing and a failing run.

capabilities.name: Container basics with Docker
capabilities.definition: Build and run an application image with explicitly declared runtime dependencies.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Build a small image and run it with a documented port mapping.

capabilities.name: Node.js runtime basics
capabilities.definition: Run a server-side JavaScript program and handle an HTTP request with Node.js.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Start a small HTTP server and explain its request handler and response.

capabilities.name: TypeScript basics
capabilities.definition: Use static type annotations and type checking to catch incompatible values.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Type-check a small program and explain a caught type mismatch.

capabilities.name: Relational data modelling
capabilities.definition: Choose tables, keys and referential constraints for a small relational model.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Model two related entities and demonstrate a foreign-key constraint.

capabilities.name: HTTP authentication and access checks
capabilities.definition: Explain HTTP credential challenges and distinguish failed authentication from denied access.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Explain a 401 and a 403 response and why Basic credentials require HTTPS.

capabilities.name: Functional test automation
capabilities.definition: Maintain a repeatable functional check against an application and diagnose a failed run.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Run an isolated browser/API check and inspect a failure without masking it.

capabilities.name: Test-case design
capabilities.definition: Choose meaningful test cases and expected outcomes from user-visible requirements.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Describe normal, boundary and failure cases and the requirement each checks.

capabilities.name: Python
capabilities.definition: Write Python functions and use core data structures in a small program.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Transform a small dataset with functions and handle an invalid input.

capabilities.name: Reproducible defect reporting
capabilities.definition: Describe an observed defect with reproduction steps, expected/actual results and relevant evidence.
capabilities.observableOutcome: Prepare a fictional defect report that another person can reproduce.
